name: Hanze University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences university in Groningen with project-based degrees for clients, from business and engineering to a conservatoire and art academy.

ib.text: The IB Diploma meets the HAVO-level entry for 4-year programmes and counts as VWO-level for the 3-year ones. It also exempts you from the English test.

dates.label: General application deadline, non-EU students (September 2027 start)
General application deadline, EU students (September 2027 start)

programmes.name: Applied Computer Science
programmes.about: Software that runs on devices, machines and systems rather than only on screens: the programme combines software and hardware over four years, moving from foundations to a specialisation and professional practice.
programmes.overview: Year one lays foundations in programming, electronics, computer architecture, networking, operating systems and mathematics, and year two adds network design and security, distributed systems, and machine learning and AI applications. Teaching is based on practical projects with fellow students on real-world problems, in teams that mirror professional settings. In year three you choose a focus and take a minor at Hanze or elsewhere, including abroad, and year four includes an internship at a national or international company. Graduates work as embedded or software engineers, IoT developers, AI engineers, cybersecurity specialists or data engineers, or continue to a master such as Smart Systems Engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August.

programmes.name: Classical Music
programmes.ib: Prince Claus Conservatoire; taught in Dutch and English. Audition (video pre-selection for violin, voice, piano); apply by 1 March in 2026, 2027 date not yet published.
programmes.about: Train as a versatile classical performer and teacher on one of some two dozen instruments or voice, with orchestra and chamber-music stage experience, pedagogy, entrepreneurship and work placements.
programmes.overview: Your main instrument or voice stays central, supported by theory classes, practical training, projects, an introduction to teaching your own instrument and entrepreneurial skills. Playing in an ensemble or orchestra is a core part of the curriculum, with masterclasses and workshops led by international musicians. Placements are arranged with partners such as the North Netherlands Orchestra and music schools, and a biennial symphony orchestra project is run with HFK Bremen. Electives follow your interests, and exchange is possible in later years. Graduates perform as ensemble musicians, orchestral players or soloists, combine performing with teaching, or continue to the Master of Music in Classical Music.
programmes.selectionNote: Motivation letter; video pre-selection for violin, voice and piano; then a live audition in Groningen with a theory test. 2026 deadline 1 March; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Creative Media & Game Technologies
programmes.ib: Maths required with a pass (Hanze sets no IB level). An online personality survey (MPT) within 10 working days of applying is compulsory.
programmes.about: Design and build games and interactive experiences with Unity, Unreal Engine, AR/VR and virtual production, learning through projects for real clients rather than exams.
programmes.overview: Year one runs in blocks on Design & Prototyping, 2D Game Development, 3D Games & Assets, and Production & Reflection; year two brings client projects using VR, AR, AI and virtual production, focus tracks, electives and a Game Lab for building a releasable game. You learn by making things in international teams rather than through exams, using the Makerspace and Spacelab for prototypes. Year three is an industry internship and year four a capstone project with external clients. Graduates work as game designers, 3D artists, UI/UX designers, game developers, technical artists or studio entrepreneurs, or continue to a master in digital transformation or international communication.

needs.note: A pass on your final results; Hanze sets no IB level. The OMPT-A maths test (55%) can make up for it.

programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. An online Multicultural Personality Test is compulsory.

programmes.name: Design
programmes.ib: Minerva Art Academy; taught in Dutch and English. Portfolio, then home assignment and interview; portfolio due 1 June in 2026, 2027 date not yet published.
programmes.about: A broad design degree: in the first year you try all six majors (graphic & interaction, illustration & animation, spatial, time-based, product, OffRoad) before choosing one, working through studio, lab and theory classes.
programmes.overview: The first year introduces all six majors and builds design research, concept development, experiments with materials and media, and 2D, 3D and 4D work in studio, lab, theory and workshop classes. You then specialise in Graphic & Interaction Design, Illustration & Animation Design, Spatial Design, Time Based Design, Product Design or OffRoad, developing professional skills and learning how design shapes its context. Project weeks bring disciplines together, and minors, electives and a semester abroad or internship are possible in year three. Year four is an independent graduation project. Graduates work in independent studios, agencies or their own projects, or continue to a master or research.
programmes.selectionNote: Round 1: portfolio with motivation and CV (1 June in 2026). Round 2: home assignment and a 10-minute online interview. 2027 date not yet published.

programmes.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.ib: Maths required (Hanze sets no IB level).
programmes.about: Design, build and programme electronic solutions in hands-on projects for real clients, specialising from year 3 in Mechatronics, Sensors & Smart Systems or Energy & Power Electronics.
programmes.overview: The first two years cover analogue and digital electronics, embedded programming, PLCs, robotics, data communication, drive systems and control systems, taught through hands-on projects for real clients, workshops at Van Doorenveste and the Hanze Makerspace. Year three includes an internship and the degree ends with a graduation project at a company or organisation. In years three and four you choose Mechatronics, Sensors & Smart Systems, or Energy & Power Electronics, and can take minors or study abroad. Graduates work as electrical, automation, embedded software, hardware or mechatronics engineers, with employers such as ASML and Philips, or continue to a master such as Smart Systems Engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. Applying from May on, a non-binding Study Choice Check is compulsory.

programmes.name: Fine Art
programmes.ib: Minerva Art Academy; taught in Dutch and English. Portfolio, motivation letter and CV uploaded in Hanze Apply by 1 June 2027, then an admission interview.
programmes.about: A studio-based route to becoming an independent visual artist, where making and thinking go together across media, with tutors who are practising artists and options for exchange, minors and research projects.
programmes.overview: Studio work is at the heart of the degree: in shared studios you start an artistic process and make independent work, supported by theory on contemporary art, professional practice, technical workshops and labs, and electives. Assignments come from the academy's Project Bureau and Art & Society Research Centre, there are excursions abroad, and students show work in public exhibitions and a joint graduation show. Year three offers a semester at a partner academy or an in-house minor, and honours projects are available. The academy in Groningen leads on to four master programmes. Graduates build a practice as independent artists, in their own workshop or a shared one.
programmes.selectionNote: Round 1: one PDF with portfolio, motivation letter and CV by 1 June 2027. Round 2: home assignment and a 10-minute online interview with two tutors and a student.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.ib: IB Diploma holders may take the 3-year version instead. Applying from May on means a compulsory Study Choice Check.

family.name: International Business
family.differs: The four-year BBA. Hanze says IB Diploma holders may take the 3-year version instead.
family.cardLine: Also open to you; a year longer

programmes.about: Business fundamentals (marketing, finance, supply chain, HR) with a compulsory year abroad: a semester at one of 120+ partner universities plus an international placement, and a foreign language from five.
programmes.overview: Year one introduces organisational strategy, economics, finance, marketing, business communication and intercultural competence, and year two deepens finance and accounting, operations and logistics, human resource management and international marketing, alongside a foreign language of your choice. You work on real-life projects with business clients and play business simulations such as designing a market-entry strategy. Year three is spent abroad, with a study semester at one of 120 or more partner universities and an international internship. Year four adds electives in marketing, finance or HR and consulting for an external company. Graduates become marketing, finance or account managers, consultants or entrepreneurs, or continue to an MBA.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. Applying from May on, a non-binding Study Choice Check is compulsory.

programmes.name: International Business (3-year)
programmes.ib: For VWO-level diplomas such as the IB Diploma. Applying from May on means a compulsory Study Choice Check.

family.name: International Business
family.differs: The three-year BBA, for VWO-level diplomas such as the IB Diploma.
family.cardLine: Open to you with the IB Diploma

programmes.about: The same International Business degree compressed into three years for pre-university diplomas, with a compulsory year abroad (partner-university semester and international internship) and a heavier self-study load.
programmes.overview: The first year covers marketing, finance and accounting, supply chain management, human resource management, personal and intercultural development, business communication and an additional foreign language. You work through integrated business cases and simulation games in which you run a company. The second year takes you abroad for a semester at one of 120 or more partner universities and a placement at an organisation outside your home country. In the final year you act as a consultant for an external company, choose electives in marketing, finance or HR, and complete a graduation project on a business problem. Graduates become marketing, finance or project managers, consultants or entrepreneurs, or continue to a master or MBA.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. Applying from May on, a non-binding Study Choice Check is compulsory.

programmes.name: International Communication
programmes.about: How stories, news and campaigns shape opinion: PR and marketing, crisis communication and public affairs, consultancy and media writing, with a second year spent as a consultant on real client briefs.
programmes.overview: You study visual communication and design, communication and media theory, crisis and reputation management, PR and marketing, public affairs, media writing and event organisation. Teaching is project-based with real clients: you design campaigns, create corporate identities and websites, and produce live talk shows, trying every production role from host to camera operator, using the Mediadesk and Medialab. Year three brings an internship abroad or an exchange semester, and you can take a minor in Language and Communication, Business and Economics, or Science and Engineering. Graduates work as PR advisors, communications coordinators, brand identity consultants, event managers or social media strategists, or continue to a master such as International Communication.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August.

programmes.name: International Facility Management
programmes.about: How organisations run their services and spaces: semesters alternate between services and (work)space management, with hospitality, health and sustainability in view. One of two English-taught FM degrees in the Netherlands.
programmes.overview: Year one introduces facility management as the creation of sustainable, innovative work environments, with service management from the customer view and human resource management. Year two focuses on service innovation and spaces in hospitality, health or sustainability, using design thinking. You work on projects with real clients, in living labs with researchers and entrepreneurs, for example on indoor climate in workspaces, and on field trips. Year three has a five-month internship as assistant manager and a minor or exchange abroad, and year four ends with a graduation project. Graduates work as facility, event, sustainability or operations managers, hospitality managers or consultants, or move on to a master.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. A February start is also possible, with an earlier deadline.

programmes.name: International Finance & Control
programmes.about: Business finance for international organisations: a first year of financial and economic basics, then business economics and information provision, practised in projects for real clients.
programmes.overview: The early years build international finance and economics, management accounting, international business law and corporate finance. Each period pairs two theory courses with a group project run with the Scrum method, and in year two you take on cases for real companies. Year three includes exchange at a partner university and an internship at an internationally oriented organisation in the Netherlands or abroad, with minors and an honours programme as options, and year four ends with a graduation research project. Graduates become financial managers, business analysts, controllers, management accountants, treasury managers or entrepreneurs, or continue to a master such as Business Studies.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August.

programmes.name: Jazz
programmes.ib: Prince Claus Conservatoire; taught in Dutch and English. Video pre-selection, then audition; apply by 1 March in 2026, 2027 date not yet published.
programmes.about: Become a professional jazz musician through weekly lessons with Dutch and international jazz players, with performance on stage from the first year alongside theory.
programmes.overview: Your main instrument or voice is taught in one-to-one lessons with professional jazz musicians, alongside ensemble work in big band, vocal ensemble and small groups, music theory applied to playing, piano skills for non-pianists, and a repertoire of jazz standards with melody, accompaniment and improvisation. You perform in public from the start, take masterclasses with guest musicians, join themed project weeks and studio recording projects, and can spend a third-year exchange at conservatories in Europe or America. Groningen offers De Oosterpoort and a local club circuit. Graduates build portfolio careers combining performing, composing and arranging, and teaching, or continue to the Master of Music New York Jazz.
programmes.selectionNote: Motivation letter and three pre-selection videos, then a live audition in Groningen with a group theory test. 2026 deadline 1 March; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Marketing Management
programmes.about: Find out what customers need and want and how to win them for a brand, through theory and project work for real companies in an international classroom.
programmes.overview: The first year covers international marketing, corporate communication, sales and business development, economics and organisation theory, and intercultural competence. You work in international groups on real company assignments and integrated projects, take part in a two-day hackathon, and finish with a graduation project commissioned by an external organisation. Year three includes an internship and a 30-credit minor at Hanze or a partner university abroad, and an honours programme is available. Graduates work in social media and digital marketing, account management, communications and sales management or start their own businesses, or continue to the MSc Business Studies.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. From May on a selection check is compulsory; its advice is not binding.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.ib: VWO-level entry: Maths and Physics "at advanced level" (Hanze gives no HL/SL rule). EU applicants apply by 1 July.
programmes.about: A three-year engineering bachelor built on real projects from day one, which gives direct entry to Hanze's European Master in Renewable Energy or Smart Systems Engineering: an MSc in four and a half years.
programmes.overview: The first year covers product analysis, applied mechanics, energy technology, materials engineering, manufacturing technology and professional skills. You learn by doing: real engineering challenges for actual clients from the start, lab practicals, and hands-on work with small systems such as combustion engines, drives and installations. Year two includes a placement at a company of your choice, and year three allows a minor at Hanze, another Dutch university or abroad. The programme has a focus on the energy transition through the EnTranCe centre of expertise, and an honours track exists. Graduates work as power plant, installations or maintenance engineers, in R&D or technical sales, or continue to a master such as Renewable Energy.

needs.note: Hanze asks for maths "at advanced level" (VWO) and gives no IB HL/SL rule.
Hanze asks for physics "at advanced level" (VWO) and gives no IB HL/SL rule.

programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the VWO-level entry with maths and physics and you are admitted. EU/EEA applicants must meet the requirements by 1 July.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.ib: Selective: apply by 15 January 2027, then a registration form, online tests and an online selection day (10 February). HAVO-level entry; no subjects required.
programmes.about: Help people with movement problems move well again, combining medical-biological knowledge, treatment methods, behavioural psychology, communication and entrepreneurship, with much practice on peers and in clinics.
programmes.overview: Year one covers anatomy, pathology, patient examination, evidence-based practice, conversation skills and professional development, and year two moves to heart and lung conditions, neurological disorders such as dementia and Parkinson disease, and complex movement problems. You practise on each other, work on projects for real clients and do short placements in year one, followed by external clinical placements and a graduation placement in years three and four. Minors, for example in Physiotherapy & Sport, or an exchange abroad are possible. Graduates work in hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation, private practice, gyms, schools and occupational health, or continue to a master.
programmes.selectionNote: Selective: registration form and online motivation and learning-styles test by 10 Feb, then a test on lecture material at an online selection day. Ranking in mid-April.

programmes.name: Popular Culture
programmes.ib: Minerva Art Academy; taught in Dutch and English. Portfolio with a one-minute video, then an admission assessment; 2027 admission dates not yet published.
programmes.about: Make interdisciplinary performance work for audiences as a performer, writer/composer or visualiser/designer, learning in a production-house model with cultural institutions in Leeuwarden.
programmes.overview: Year one is organised around six group projects, such as exploring pop culture trends by theme, pitching concepts to clients, learning artistic direction and getting media attention for social issues, next to your own individual projects. Year two adds design research, concept development and grant applications, and you work in a production house, labs and in-depth core subjects within communities of learners. Year three brings an internship at cultural organisations or a minor in the Netherlands or abroad, and year four ends with an essay, an artistic concept and a realised performance production. Graduates work as performers, songwriters, producers, filmmakers, festival developers or podcasters, or continue to the MA Fine Art and Design.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio showing some cultural experience plus a one-minute video, then an admission assessment day. 2026 had monthly rounds March to August; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Sport Studies
programmes.ib: VWO-level entry (IB Diploma). Apply by 15 June; online matching day and a sports medical fitness test.
programmes.about: A three-year degree on the role of sport in health, the economy and society, working on real challenges with professional sports organisations throughout.
programmes.overview: The programme looks at sport through three values: its health, economic and social value. Throughout the degree you complete challenges, practical assignments in professional organisations, with work-based learning each year, plus a compulsory Outdoor Experience in year one and a Wintersport Experience in year two. You can use campus facilities such as the Equipment Centre, Sports Field Lab and Swimming School, choose electives, study abroad during a challenge, or join the honours education. Graduates work as sport marketers, event managers, sports entrepreneurs, coaches, policy officers or community developers, or continue to a master such as Healthy Ageing Professional.
programmes.selectionNote: Binding: a motivation letter and online matching day, then a sports medical fitness test (about €190); both must be positive. Apply by 15 June.

notes: The Prince Claus Conservatoire and Minerva Art Academy are part of Hanze: you apply through Studielink, but an audition or portfolio decides, with earlier deadlines.
With an IB Diploma you can take the 3-year International Business, Mechanical Engineering or Sport Studies, which are meant for VWO-level students.
Popular Culture is taught in Leeuwarden, not Groningen.
